title: Easier learner sites and visit addresses
details: Learner profiles can keep a mentor name and permanent site address for quick reference
Calendar bookings automatically use the learner's permanent site address, but it can be changed for one visit without altering the profile
Pressing a visit address opens the assessor's preferred maps app for directions from the current location
Mileage and route planning use the booking address when a visit has moved to a different site
Assessment, review, observation, evidence and QR workflows are unchanged
